role: Observational recording/history around the unchanged synthetic R2 plant

clock_and_identity.observation_identity: Original observation timestamp plus canonical full-packet digest; R2 has no independent observation sequence
clock_and_identity.identical_duplicates: No history append, no current decision context, no new evidence
clock_and_identity.conflicting_or_regressing_input: Latched recorder fault; clear active feature window and issued ledger
clock_and_identity.stale_on_arrival: Retain a valid original packet for diagnosis with unknown aged features and no decision context
clock_and_identity.pose_motion_range_watermarks: Original timestamps/content and range sequence; held frames are not new samples
clock_and_identity.record_sequence: Local recording counter, never represented as a device/camera sample sequence

boundaries.manual_disarm_unavailable_context: Clear active decision history and ledger; retain bounded diagnostic records
boundaries.cancel: Clear recorder context only; no STOP or physical command generated
boundaries.resume_after_cancel: New accepted observation and new valid caller-supplied request with increasing original sequence
boundaries.fault_reset: Explicit fresh newer disarmed observation; preserve sequence/time high-water marks
boundaries.new_episode_or_device_sequence_restart: Create a new explicitly owned stream; do not silently rewind watermarks

decisions.operator_assistance: RECOVERY_REQUEST only through explicit operator record path; API distinction is not authentication
decisions.null_request: Retain exactly null; no automatic resend or lifetime extension
decisions.invalid_original_request: Keep request and resulting simulated transition when the input observation was accepted

scope_limits: Accepted JSON packets/transitions retain full input; malformed/oversized/rejected observations and subsequent latched-fault frames have event metadata only.
Bounded recording is not complete historical Q-training reconstruction or a hardware watchdog.
Recorded digital ACK is not measured propulsion; neutral output is not proof of stationary position.
Payload tags and operator owner fields are research provenance checks, not an authentication boundary.
